It's just a maglev bullet train that goes through a partially evacuated tunnel to reduce air friction, as far as I can see. Similar things have appeared occasionally in sci-fi for decades, it's a pretty obvious idea, just stupidly expensive to build.

The thing I find most interesting here is the self sustaining power of the system. That's just simply cool. It's crazy how far and how fast we've come in solar power. What was, like 10 years ago, when even hybrid vehicle solutions were basically glorified go-carts now we have pure electric Teslas hitting 0 to 60 faster than a McLaren F1 and now the technical design to construct a high subsonic transportation system on pure self sustaining electric power.
